description: This file defines the interface for managing LwM2M server objects, including resource IDs, configuration functions, and server state management functions.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_get_pmin
methods.description: Returns the default minimum period for an observation set for the server.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_get_pmax
methods.description: Returns the default maximum period for an observation set for the server.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_get_ssid
methods.description: Returns the Short Server ID of the server object instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_short_id_to_inst
methods.description: Returns the object instance id of the server having the given ssid.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the given server instance is not disabled.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_select
methods.description: Selects a server instance considering server data and priorities.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_disable
methods.description: Disables a server instance for a specified timeout period.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_get_disabled_time
methods.description: Gets the timepoint until which the server instance is disabled.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_get_prio
methods.description: Gets the priority of a server instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_reset_timestamps
methods.description: Resets all disable-timers for all server instances.

methods.name: lwm2m_server_get_mute_send
methods.description: Gets the mute send status for a server instance (version 1.1).
